## Interactions & Behaviors

### Team table interactions

- **"Edit" action link** → Opens the "Edit [Name]" modal for that team member (exactly what is shown for Matt Ryan in this screenshot). Modal is positioned overlapping the table, right-of-center.
- **"Delete" action link** → [INFERRED: Shows a confirmation dialog asking "Are you sure you want to remove [Name] from your team?" with Cancel/Confirm buttons. Owner row has no Delete option — the account owner cannot be removed.]
- **Role dropdown (Admin ↓, Agent ↓)** → [INFERRED: Clicking opens an inline dropdown with role options: Owner, Admin, Agent. Selecting a new value saves immediately or requires a save step.]
- **"Can Export" checkbox** → [INFERRED: Toggling directly in the table row changes the export permission for that user and saves immediately (no modal).]
- **"Pause Leads" checkbox** → [INFERRED: Toggling pauses lead routing to that team member. They stop receiving new lead assignments while paused. Saves immediately.]
- **"+ Add Team Members" button** → [INFERRED: Opens a modal or inline form to invite a new team member by email. May also allow searching for existing FUB contacts to promote to team members.]
- **"? How Teams work" link** → [INFERRED: Opens FUB's help documentation in a new tab or inline help drawer explaining team roles, permissions, and group assignments.]

### Modal interactions

- **"×" close button** → Dismisses the modal without saving; returns to the dimmed team table, which returns to normal (scrim removed)
- **"Cancel" button** → Same as ×: dismisses without saving
- **"Save" button** → Submits the form via API call (PATCH or PUT to FUB API for the user record); on success, dismisses the modal and reflects updated values in the team table; on error, shows inline validation [INFERRED]
- **First Name / Last Name inputs** → Plain text inputs, no character restrictions visible. Both required [INFERRED].
- **Login Email input** → Email-type text input. [INFERRED: must be unique across the FUB account; changing email may trigger a re-verification email to the new address.]
- **Phone Number input** → Plain text input storing digits without formatting. [INFERRED: used for call forwarding and SMS within FUB's dialer/texting system.]
- **User Merge Field "?" tooltip** → [INFERRED: Hovering or clicking reveals an explanation such as "This value can be inserted into email/text templates using the {{agent.merge_field}} merge tag."]
- **Role dropdown (in modal)** → Clicking opens a dropdown with role options. For the Owner, the role may be non-changeable (it shows "Owner" and may be disabled/read-only since there can only be one owner). [INFERRED]
- **Group multi-select** → [INFERRED: Clicking opens a multi-select dropdown listing all available groups (Smart Lists / routing groups) in the account. The user can be added to or removed from multiple groups. Current value "Team Ryan, Seller Leads" may be a single group with that exact name, or two separate group assignments displayed comma-separated.]
- **"Notify about all new inquiries in Follow Up Boss" checkbox** → [INFERRED: When enabled, the team member receives an email/push notification for every new lead that enters FUB, regardless of whether the lead is assigned to them. Useful for team owners who want full visibility. Paired with the "?" tooltip that presumably explains this notification behavior.]
- **Clicking outside modal / on scrim** → [INFERRED: May dismiss the modal (standard modal behavior) or may require explicit Cancel/× click. FUB modals sometimes prevent click-outside dismiss to avoid accidental loss of edits.]

## Data Model Signals

**`users` / `team_members` entity:**
- `id` — internal FUB user ID
- `first_name` — string ("Matt")
- `last_name` — string ("Ryan")
- `login_email` — string, unique ("matt@ryan-realty.com")
- `phone_number` — string, digits only ("5412136706")
- `user_merge_field` — string, nullable (custom merge-tag value for templates)
- `role` — enum: `owner` | `admin` | `agent`
- `can_export` — boolean (whether user can export contact/lead data)
- `pause_leads` — boolean (whether lead routing is paused for this user)
- `group_ids` / `groups` — array of group/list references ("Team Ryan, Seller Leads")
- `notify_all_inquiries` — boolean
- `last_login_at` — timestamp (displayed as relative "a minute ago", "4 months ago")
- `last_activity_at` — timestamp (second timestamp column: "an hour ago", "5 days ago")
- `avatar_url` — URL to circular profile photo

**`groups` / `routing_groups` entity:**
- `id` — internal ID
- `name` — string ("Team Ryan, Seller Leads")
- Members are `users`

**`roles` enum:**
- `owner` — highest permission, one per account, cannot be deleted, can export by default
- `admin` — elevated permissions, can be changed to other roles, can be deleted
- `agent` — standard team member role, can be changed, can be deleted

**`team` entity:**
- `member_count` — integer (3 in this case)
- Associated with the FUB account (`ryan-realty`, account ID `2` as seen in URL path `/2/teams`)

**Relationships visible:**
- Account (1) → Team Members (many)
- Team Member → Role (one)
- Team Member → Groups (many-to-many)
- Team Member → Can Export flag (one boolean)
- Team Member → Pause Leads flag (one boolean)

### Non-obvious logic

1. **Owner row restrictions:** The Owner role row shows only "Edit" in Actions (no "Delete"). This is enforced at the UI level — the account owner cannot be removed from the team or have their role changed to non-owner without a specific ownership-transfer flow (not visible here). The "Edit" modal still opens but Role dropdown for Owner may be disabled.

2. **Can Export checkbox is pre-checked for Owner:** Matt Ryan (Owner) has "Can Export" checked by default; the two non-owner members do not. This may be enforced as a default when creating the owner account, or may have been manually enabled.

3. **Phone number stored without formatting:** The value `5412136706` has no dashes or spaces. Display formatting (if any) would be applied in the UI layer, not stored. This is the number FUB uses for call forwarding and click-to-call in its dialer system.

4. **User Merge Field empty string vs null:** The empty input suggests this field is optional and may be stored as empty string or null; templates that reference `{{agent.merge_field}}` would render nothing for Matt Ryan.

5. **Group assignment display:** "Team Ryan, Seller Leads" in the Group multi-select pill — this could be either (a) a single group whose name contains a comma, or (b) two separate groups shown comma-separated in the pill display. Given FUB's group naming conventions, "Team Ryan, Seller Leads" is most likely one group. A proper multi-select would render each group as a separate pill/chip; if only one pill is shown, it is likely one group with this exact name.

6. **Relative timestamps:** The table shows two timestamp columns with relative time strings ("a minute ago", "5 days ago", etc.) suggesting these are computed client-side from absolute UTC timestamps using a library like moment.js or date-fns `formatDistanceToNow`. The two columns likely correspond to "Last Login" (when the user last authenticated) and "Last Active" or "Last Lead Activity" (when they last interacted with a lead).

7. **Scrim click behavior:** [INFERRED] FUB typically prevents modal dismiss on outside click to avoid accidental form abandonment. The Cancel button and × button are the only dismissal paths.

8. **No "How Teams work" CTA in the modal** — help is only at the sub-nav strip level, not inside the modal itself (except for the two field-level "?" tooltip icons).

9. **Role dropdown inline in table vs modal:** Non-owner members show a role dropdown directly in the table row (Admin ↓, Agent ↓) for quick role changes without opening the full edit modal. The edit modal also has the role field, so it can be changed from either surface.

10. **Avatar source:** Circular headshots suggest FUB either integrates with Gravatar (email-hash based) or stores uploaded profile photos. Matt Ryan has a visible real headshot photo in his row.
